items.docs:
List all registered webhooks.

Required API key permissions: `Admin` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)

params.name: name
params.description: The name given to the webhook

params.name: hook_url
params.description: The URL used for sending notifications

params.name: notification_type_ids
params.description:
The list of notifications to subscribe to. For a list of supported notification
types and their IDs use the /api/public/webhooks/notification_types endpoint.

params.name: webhook_type
params.description: The type of webhook to create

items.docs:
Create a new webhook subscribing to the provided list of notifications.

Required API key permissions: `Admin` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the webhook to delete

items.docs:
Delete a webhook by ID.

Required API key permissions: `Admin` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)

Get a list of available webhook notification types and their descriptions for your organisation.

Required API key permissions: `Admin` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)

params.name: id
params.description:
The ID of a webhook. If specified sample data for all the
notification types registered for that webhook will be returned.

params.name: notification_type_ids
params.description:
A list of notification type IDs you need sample data for.
If a webhook ID is provided this parameter is ignored.

items.docs:
Get the example data for one or more notification types.

Required API key permissions: `Admin` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)
